# Barış Salih Babacan — Systems Engineer & CTO

> Portfolio of Barış Salih Babacan, CTO at Garage.ist, an Istanbul product studio. He builds local-first infrastructure in Rust, reverse-engineers network protocols, and ships native iOS and Android apps. He is also a novelist.

## Core Profile
- **Role**: CTO & Lead Developer @ Garage.ist (since Oct 2024; two-developer team) · Systems Engineer
- **Location**: Istanbul, Turkey (open to remote)
- **Education**: Associate degree in Computer Programming, Istanbul University (2024–present); Haydarpaşa Vocational & Technical High School, Network Management & Cyber Security (2020–2024)
- **Email**: barissalih@babacan.me
- **Website**: https://babacan.me
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/barissalihbabacan
- **LinkedIn**: https://linkedin.com/in/barissalihbabacan
- **CV**: https://babacan.me/cv/Baris_Salih_Babacan_CV_EN.pdf (Turkish: https://babacan.me/cv/Baris_Salih_Babacan_CV_TR.pdf)

## Focus
- **Local-first systems in Rust**: content-addressable storage (BLAKE3 + SQLite), Unix-socket daemons, JSON-RPC over stdio. Peer-to-peer sync is on the Osmos roadmap, not yet implemented.
- **Network protocol reverse engineering**: undocumented device APIs, HTTP Digest auth, PIN pairing, self-signed TLS.
- **Native apps**: SwiftUI/MVVM on iOS and iPadOS, Android, Tauri on desktop.

## Open-Source & Personal Projects

### Osmos
- **Description**: Local-first version control engine. Three-crate Rust workspace (osmos-core, osmos-daemon, osmos-transport) with BLAKE3 blob storage, SQLite metadata and a Unix-socket daemon. Early Tauri 2 + React desktop client. Status: alpha; mDNS/QUIC peer sync planned.
- **Role**: Founder & Lead Developer (2026–)
- **Tech**: Rust · Tauri · React · TypeScript · SQLite · BLAKE3
- **URL**: https://github.com/Osmos-App/osmos-core
- **Page**: https://babacan.me/en/projects/osmos

### Mythos
- **Description**: Local-first IDE for novelists. The engine (mythoside-core) is a six-crate Rust workspace that models manuscripts as Markdown + YAML on disk and exposes 13 JSON-RPC methods over stdio; a Tauri 2 + React client runs it as a sidecar. 82 tests. A SQLite FTS5 index is planned.
- **Role**: Creator & Developer (2026)
- **Tech**: Rust · Tauri · React · TypeScript
- **URL**: https://github.com/Mythos-IDE/mythoside-core
- **Page**: https://babacan.me/en/projects/mythos

### Chorus
- **Description**: Anonymous discussion engine that stores every thread and message as a Git commit, with thread-scoped temporary identities instead of accounts. v0.1.0-alpha; 24 tests and 5 benchmarks.
- **Role**: Founding Engineer (2026–)
- **Tech**: Go 1.22+ · React · TypeScript · Vite · Git
- **URL**: https://github.com/joinchorus/chorus · https://joinchorus.app
- **Page**: https://babacan.me/en/projects/chorus

### IT-RMS (IT Resource Management System)
- **Description**: IT asset, inventory and lab management system for a vocational high school's IT department: 2D lab layouts, barcode/QR labels, stock alerts and a five-role user model. Built in PHP 8 + MySQL starting in 2023; migration to Node.js, Express 5 and MongoDB is in progress, with the PHP version kept on a branch.
- **Role**: Lead Architect & Developer (2023–)
- **Tech**: PHP 8 · MySQL · Node.js · Express · MongoDB (Mongoose)
- **URL**: https://github.com/barissalihbabacan/IT-Department-Resource-Management-System
- **Page**: https://babacan.me/en/projects/itrms

### Q-PASS
- **Description**: RFID access control and meal tracking with custom 3D-printed readers. C++ firmware bridged over serial to a Python service and a PHP/MySQL dashboard. Ran at Haydarpaşa MTAL for three school years, serving 120–150 people a day. No longer in use.
- **Role**: System Architect
- **Tech**: Arduino (C++) · Python · PHP · MySQL · RFID
- **URL**: https://github.com/barissalihbabacan/Q-PASS-RFID-Access-Control
- **Page**: https://babacan.me/en/projects/qpass

## Garage.ist Projects

### Sortify
- **Description**: Game-based learning app for children aged 3–13, with supervision tools for parents and teachers. Native SwiftUI on iOS/iPadOS, six in-house Swift packages, Firebase, server-side StoreKit 2 verification. v2.3 on the App Store, 540+ commits.
- **Role**: CTO & Lead Developer
- **URL**: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6759790866
- **Page**: https://babacan.me/en/projects/sortify

### Sortify Web
- **Description**: Browser client of Sortify, porting the iOS game logic to React 19 + TypeScript + HTML5 Canvas.
- **Role**: Lead Developer
- **Page**: https://babacan.me/en/projects/playsortify

### +TV
- **Description**: Android TV remote, cast and screen-mirroring app with 10K+ downloads on Google Play, built with a fellow developer. Samsung via the Tizen SDK, LG via ConnectSDK. He wrote the Philips integration alone by reverse-engineering the undocumented JointSpace API (CatLog logs, Wireshark traffic): HTTP Digest auth over a 401 challenge–response, PIN pairing as a state machine, self-signed TLS.
- **Role**: Co-developer · Philips integration
- **URL**: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.plus.plustvv001
- **Page**: https://babacan.me/en/projects/plus-tv

### World Clock
- **Description**: Interactive time zone map with D3 orthographic projections, solar terminator and a meeting planner, prerendered for SEO.
- **Role**: Lead Developer
- **Tech**: React 18 · D3.js · TopoJSON · Vite
- **URL**: https://worldclock.info
- **Page**: https://babacan.me/en/projects/worldclock

### Gayrimenkul Dünyası
- **Description**: Real estate data collection and CRM platform (Next.js, Playwright, Cloud Firestore).
- **Role**: Backend Integration & Firebase Infrastructure
- **Page**: https://babacan.me/en/projects/gayrimenkuldunyasi

### Spor Sayfası
- **Description**: Sports news portal (Next.js). His part: Firebase infrastructure, hosting, record persistence and news-ingestion fixes.
- **Role**: Infrastructure & Backend Integration
- **Page**: https://babacan.me/en/projects/sporsayfasi

### Rule Sort
- **Description**: Endless reflex game for iPhone and iPad: swipe each falling object left or right by the current rule (warm/cool, round/angular, small/big); the rule, and sometimes the controls, flip mid-run. Daily Challenge with a global Game Center leaderboard, Legendary memory mode.
- **Role**: Developer · App Store release
- **URL**: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6807764876
- **Page**: https://babacan.me/en/projects/rulesort

### Block Nest
- **Description**: 8×8 block-fitting puzzle for iPhone and iPad with Karo Mode (45° diamond board), a Gravity Wheel and diagonal pieces. Fully offline, Game Center leaderboards, localized into 13 languages.
- **Role**: Developer · App Store release
- **URL**: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6808679766
- **Page**: https://babacan.me/en/projects/blocknest

## Publications

### Babaların Günahları (The Sins of the Fathers)
- **Format**: Novel (psychological fiction / drama)
- **Status**: Under review, submitted to the Everest First Novel Award
- **Summary**: A three-generation family saga from the streets of Scotland to the towers of Los Angeles, about inherited guilt, moral responsibility and conscience.
- **Official Site**: https://thesinsofthefathers.com
